facts.text: "Korben, this chicken is very good. I will have another one, and so will you."
facts.why: Leeloo never says this. It is in quote marks and signed Leeloo, so it reads as a film line. Her real lines are short, like her fifth element speech.
facts.fix: Me fifth element, supreme being. Me protect you.

fix_note.text: Me fifth element, supreme being. Me protect you.

facts.why: In the transcript Korben introduces her as Leeloo Dallas Multipass at check-in. It is Leeloo's pass, not Korben's.

facts.text: The Fhloston Paradise dinner during the Diva's song.
facts.why: Wikipedia has a concert by Plavalaguna on Fhloston, and the Mangalores attack during it. No dinner is shown during the song.
facts.fix: the Fhloston Paradise opera night, until the Mangalores crash it

facts.text: She eats like she's never eaten before.
facts.why: No source shows Leeloo eating hungrily. The transcript only has her learning our history and a line 'Chicken... good!' in the same scene.
facts.fix: Leeloo, learning our history. Chicken, good
